summary: Iteration 3 tests of NEW features complete. Backend: 14/14 pytest green (test_iter3.py). /api/coach/chat returns {reply, session_id}; /api/coach/history persists user+assistant. /api/sessions/finish returns full payload (id, makes, attempts, pct, by_zone, weak_zone, duration_sec, recap, created_at), 6-shot payload verified: makes=3/attempts=6/pct=50/weak_zone='paint' (0/2). Session shots increased /api/shots.total by exactly 6 and inserted a workout (dashboard.trained_today flipped to true). GET /api/sessions lists new session; GET /api/sessions/{id} works; unknown id -> 404; empty shots -> 400. /api/goals seeds from profile.goals with {text,target_date,progress}; /api/goals/update clamps progress (250->100, -10->0) and follow-up GET reflects saved values incl target_date='2026-12-31'. Regression: /api/dashboard has trained_today (bool) and development_score (int); /api/auth/me + signup + /shots/log still work. Frontend (Chromium via public URL): /session Start -> zone-top -> make/make/miss -> undo -> corner-L make/miss -> Finish shows AI session-recap (len=360) with result shot chart. /goals renders 3 goal cards (goal-<text>), slider persists (60), date input accepts 2026-06-30, countdown 'Nd left' shows. /compare mode toggles work; sessions mode dropdowns rendered 4 options and compare-result renders two shot charts side-by-side; analyses mode 4 options + score breakdown compare works. /analyze tabs analyze-tab-photo/video both mount form-file-input/form-analyze and film-source-upload/film-source-record; /form and /film redirect to /analyze. /report share-trend-btn present and clickable without crash. /coach coach-mic present (SpeechRecognition supported) and toggles listening state without crash. No new bugs found.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer during initial mount (chart still renders after layout settles). Consider giving the container an explicit min height.

action_items: Low priority: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer -1 width/height warning by ensuring parent has min-height on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: build_recent_context loads up to 10k shots into memory per /coach/chat call; add a Mongo $gte week-window filter (created_at >= wk_ago.isoformat()) at the query level so recent-context cost stays flat as history grows.
session_finish stores by_zone as {zone: {makes, attempts}} but GET returns dict of dicts with integer keys — fine, just make sure frontend ShotChart tolerates missing zones (it does).

GET /api/goals returns 'any stored goal not in profile.goals' concatenated after profile goals. If a user has old goals for a text the profile no longer lists, these still surface — consider a delete endpoint or a stale-goal cleanup.
coach_chat concatenates last 6 message history AND injects recent training context, growing prompt size; consider trimming based on token budget rather than fixed 6 messages once history gets long.
